comment: Query registry. Each entry: id, tier (1 basic / 2 medium / 3 complex / 4 approach-validation / 5 funnel / 6 sizing inputs / 7 conversation / 8 learned language / 9 operations / 10 follow-through / 11 cohort bridge (b-series)), file in this folder, title + question for the report, render (kpis | bars | line | table) with its column hints, story (core | context - context cards render collapsed), and columns = the exact output header (used to auto-match console CSV downloads in manual mode). Optional fallback_file runs/applies if the primary fails. Add or swap queries here without touching src/.

queries.title: Account table size and freshness
queries.question: How big is the account master, and how fresh is its newest monthly snapshot?

queries.title: Call table size, period, and account-link fill
queries.question: How many call legs, over what period, and how often is the account id populated?

queries.title: Transcript table size and history depth
queries.question: How many utterances and distinct calls do transcripts cover, and how far back does the history go?

queries.title: Calls by initiation method
queries.question: What share of call legs is inbound vs outbound vs transfer?

queries.title: Who speaks in transcripts
queries.question: Utterance split by participant; any value beyond AGENT / CUSTOMER shows up here.

queries.title: Utterance sentiment by speaker
queries.question: How does per-utterance sentiment split for customers vs agents?

queries.title: Monthly call volume by initiation method (last 12 months)
queries.question: Is call volume trending up or down, and what is the inbound share?

queries.title: Inbound calls by product type (last 6 months)
queries.question: Which product lines drive inbound volume?

queries.title: Inbound calls by vendor (last 6 months)
queries.question: How is inbound volume spread across servicing vendors?

queries.title: Inbound calls by site (last 6 months)
queries.question: Onshore vs offshore: where are inbound calls handled?

queries.title: Top queues for inbound calls (last 6 months)
queries.question: Which queues take the volume (collections vs care vs fraud)?

queries.title: Authentication outcome on inbound calls (last 6 months)
queries.question: How often do callers fail authentication (a friction signal)?

queries.title: Transfer type on inbound calls (last 6 months)
queries.question: How much inbound volume ends in a transfer, and of which kind?

queries.title: Handle-time profile, inbound handled calls (last 6 months)
queries.question: How long does an inbound call take, end to end?

queries.title: Abandon and transfer rates on inbound calls (last 6 months)
queries.question: Are callers being lost to abandons or transfer loops, and is it getting worse?

queries.title: Average call-level sentiment (last 6 months)
queries.question: How do customer and agent sentiment trend month to month?

queries.title: Utterances per transcribed call
queries.question: How long are the conversations, in spoken turns?

queries.title: Call duration from transcript timestamps
queries.question: How many minutes of conversation does a transcribed call hold?

queries.title: Accounts by delinquency bucket (latest snapshot)
queries.question: How many accounts sit in each 30-day past-due bucket, holding how much balance?

queries.title: Charge-offs by month (last 24 months of table history)
queries.question: How many accounts charge off per month, and for how much?

queries.title: Call-to-account match rate (inbound, last 6 months)
queries.question: Of recent inbound calls, how many carry an account id, and how many of those resolve to the account master? This gates every cross-table analysis.

queries.title: Transcript coverage of inbound calls, by month (last 6 months)
queries.question: What share of inbound calls has at least one transcript row? Coverage is known to be partial - this measures it.

queries.title: Repeat calling by account (inbound, last 6 months)
queries.question: Do accounts call once or repeatedly? Repeat calls signal friction or unresolved need.

queries.title: Inbound calls by caller delinquency bucket (last 6 months)
queries.question: How much inbound volume comes from delinquent accounts, and does caller mood worsen with bucket depth? Bucket read at the newest account snapshot, which may trail the calls.

queries.title: Payment language in customer utterances (inbound, last 1 month)
queries.question: In what share of transcribed inbound calls does the customer talk about paying, a plan, hardship, or escalation? A first, crude read of caller intent.

queries.title: Customer sentiment across the call (inbound, last 1 month)
queries.question: Split each call into thirds by time: does customer sentiment recover by the end of the call?

queries.title: Who opens and who closes the call (inbound, last 1 month)
queries.question: Conversation shape: who speaks first and last, and how many turns does each side take?

queries.title: Where on the DQ ladder do inbound calls land (same-month join, last 6 months)
queries.question: Tests the assumption that most inbound calls concentrate in DQ1. Caller bucket read in the month of the call, not at the latest snapshot.

queries.title: Roll / cure curve for a DQ1-entrant vintage (11 months of follow-up)
queries.question: The empirical stage-migration rates: how a new-delinquency cohort splits into cured, still delinquent, 90+, and charged-off month by month. Replaces assumed multipliers with measured ones.

queries.title: Outcomes: callers vs non-callers in the same DQ1 vintage
queries.question: The forward frame. Same cohort, split by inbound call in the first 3 delinquent months: who charges off, who cures, and how much balance sits in each group. Association, not causation.

queries.title: Entry balance by eventual outcome (DQ1 vintage)
queries.question: Tests 'balance at DQ1 = balance at risk'. Shows how entry dollars actually split between cure, still-delinquent, and charge-off.

queries.title: Payment within 30 days of an inbound call, by bucket (last 6 months)
queries.question: The capture / leakage proxy at scale: what share of delinquent-account inbound calls shows no payment within 30 days? Payment read from the next month-end snapshot (proxy).

queries.title: Provision-stage proxy from the DQ ladder (latest snapshot)
queries.question: IFRS9-style staging shape from the bucket ladder: accounts and balances in stage-1/2/3 proxies. Pair with the vintage roll curve for an evidence-based expected-loss ladder.

queries.title: Inbound vs outbound contact mix by bucket (last 6 months)
queries.question: Sizes how much of the contact volume inbound-only analysis sees, per delinquency bucket, keeping outbound separate.

queries.title: Deep-bucket resets to current (re-age / cure signal, last 6 months)
queries.question: There is no explicit re-age flag here. How often do accounts jump from DQ2+ straight back to current, per bucket? Sizes the re-age question before chasing the flag.

queries.title: Account-id fill on call legs, by month (last 24 months)
queries.question: Is the acctid fill improving over time? Lifetime fill hides the trend that decides how far back cohort joins can reach.

queries.title: Inbound calls that spawn transfer legs, by month (last 6 months)
queries.question: The real transfer rate: what share of inbound calls is followed by a TRANSFER / QUEUE_TRANSFER leg chained to it?

queries.title: Transcript coverage by initiation method (last 6 months)
queries.question: Transcribed calls outnumber inbound calls, so transcripts cover more than inbound. Which methods, and how completely?

queries.title: Top queues for delinquent callers (same-month join, last 3 account months)
queries.question: Do delinquent accounts ring collections queues or care queues? This decides the queue filter for any collections call analysis.

queries.title: Payment language: current vs delinquent callers (newest account month)
queries.question: The unconditioned payment-talk rate is an upper bound. How does payment / plan / hardship / escalation language differ once you split callers by delinquency?

queries.title: The leakage funnel, end to end (Jul 2024 - Jun 2025)
queries.question: Inbound episodes from delinquent accounts that showed payment intent, left without a CLEAN capture (autopay/NSF excluded), and charged off within 8 months - episodes (loose and strict intent), accounts, and dollars at every stage.

queries.title: The funnel by call-month vintage
queries.question: Are the stage-to-stage drops stable month over month, or does one vintage drive the story?

queries.title: The funnel by delinquency bucket
queries.question: Where on the ladder do leaked episodes and eventual losses concentrate?

queries.title: Leaked episodes and their dollars, by month
queries.question: The dollar trend behind the funnel end: leaked balances and the charge-off dollars that followed.

queries.title: Charge-off dollars: funnel-end callers vs non-callers
queries.question: Of realized charge-off dollars, how much sat on accounts the inbound channel touched and did not capture?

queries.title: Inbound episodes between DQ1 entry and charge-off
queries.question: How many chances did the inbound channel get on accounts that went on to charge off?

queries.title: Bias gate: account match by authentication outcome
queries.question: Do unmatched calls concentrate among callers who failed authentication - the very population a capture play targets?

queries.title: Bias gate: transcript coverage by bucket
queries.question: Are deep-bucket calls transcribed as often as early-bucket calls, or does the funnel undercount where the dollars are?

queries.title: Period calibration: fill and coverage by month, full history
queries.question: Which months are safe to analyse? Confirms the funnel window: reliable transcript coverage, stable account-id fill, 8 months of outcome runway.

queries.title: Calibration companion: method mix by month, full history
queries.question: When did the initiation-method mix shift? No window should be read across a mix break.

queries.title: Balance profile by bucket (live accounts)
queries.question: The per-account dollar input: average and median balance per bucket, charged-off stock excluded.

queries.title: Leading-edge roll matrix (12 months)
queries.question: Account-level month-over-month migration: cure, improve, hold, roll deeper, charge off - the measured multipliers.

queries.title: Payment size by bucket
queries.question: When a delinquent account pays, how much? The per-capture dollar value.

queries.title: Payment in-month or next: callers vs non-callers
queries.question: The self-cure baseline every capture claim must beat: payment dated in the observation month or the next, callers vs non-callers, by bucket.

queries.title: Does payment language predict payment?
queries.question: The lexicon validation: 30-day payment rates for delinquent calls with vs without payment/plan language.

queries.title: Who raises payment first?
queries.question: Arriving intent vs agent pivot: does the customer or the agent bring up payment on delinquent calls?

queries.title: Customer language across the full ladder
queries.question: Where does intent talk turn into hardship talk as delinquency deepens?

queries.title: Call effort by bucket
queries.question: Handle time, turns, and minutes per bucket - the cost side of the capture case.

queries.title: Learned lexicon: phrases that separate paid from leaked calls
queries.question: Data-derived phrase candidates: which customer bigrams mark calls that leaked, and which mark calls that paid?

queries.title: Does the platform's NLP predict payment?
queries.question: Call-level customer sentiment (model-produced) vs the 30-day payment outcome.

queries.title: Can rules rank calls? Intent score vs outcome
queries.question: An additive score from language, initiative, and tone - if payment rate climbs with it, a live read can rank calls.

queries.title: The recoverable-miss signal: agent offer vs outcome
queries.question: On calls with customer payment intent, does an agent plan-offer move the payment rate? First read of the recoverable slice.

queries.title: The invisible pool: unmatched calls, and whether they talk payment
queries.question: Which queues do acctid-less calls ring, and how often does the customer talk payment there? Transcripts join on contactid, so the invisible pool is readable.

queries.title: Days between consecutive inbound calls per account
queries.question: Friction cadence: same-day and 1-3-day repeats vs cycle-driven monthly contact.

queries.title: Cure durability: re-delinquent within 3 months
queries.question: How many cures hold? Re-delinquency after a cure discounts the cure's value and flags re-age-like resets.

queries.title: Roll / cure curve across three vintages
queries.question: Do the migration curves agree across seasons, or is the quoted roll rate one draw?

queries.title: Sensitivity: the no-payment gate at 7 / 14 / 30 / 60 days
queries.question: Does the leakage pool survive a longer payment window, or are slow payers being counted as leaked?

queries.title: Episode chaining: gap to the previous episode
queries.question: How do account-day episodes cluster? Decides whether multi-day chains should collapse into one episode, and at what window.

queries.title: Dollar-weighted roll matrix
queries.question: Where does each bucket's BALANCE go next month? Big accounts do not roll like small ones.

queries.title: Triage: dispute/fraud vs payment vs servicing-only
queries.question: How many delinquent calls are not collections conversations at all, and what does each group pay?

queries.title: Promise language and whether payment followed
queries.question: The audible promise-to-pay: future-dated promise phrases vs payment talk vs none, each with its 30-day payment rate - the kept-promise proxy.

queries.title: Early intent: is the first third of the call enough?
queries.question: If intent language in the first third already ranks calls, a live read can act mid-call; if the signal forms late, the play is follow-up.

queries.title: Capture by queue
queries.question: Which queues carry delinquent volume with the worst payment-after-call rates - the routing/coaching surface.

queries.title: Capture by vendor and site
queries.question: Does handling location move the payment rate? Spread = coaching headroom; no spread = process-shaped leakage.

queries.title: Transfers on the money path
queries.question: Are delinquent calls transferred more, and does a transferred delinquent call pay less afterwards?

queries.title: Abandons on the money path
queries.question: Delinquent callers lost before an agent, and how many never call back within a week - the purest friction leakage.

queries.title: Leaked vs captured: the account three months later
queries.question: Do captured episodes sit visibly better at month three? If yes, capture is balance-shaped money, not one payment.

queries.title: Repeat leaks and where they end
queries.question: Accounts by leaked-episode count within 90 days of the first leak, and the charge-off rate per band - the compounding-failure read.

queries.title: Time from first leak to charge-off
queries.question: Does the 8-month funnel horizon capture the loss tail, or does a fat 9-12-month band mean it undercounts?

queries.title: Scope gate: what the product-scope choice moves
queries.question: Delinquent episodes by producttype - does the blank share behave like consumer, and what does the business-card exclusion remove?

queries.title: Bucket-drift gate: month-max vs as-of-call-date bucket
queries.question: How often does the month-grain bucket tag a call with a delinquency it only reached AFTER the call? The kit's error band, measured.

queries.title: Capture-gate contamination: autopay and NSF
queries.question: Of delinquent account-months with a payment, how much is autopay firing or a bounced payment? The correction band for every capture number.

queries.title: Capture by authentication outcome
queries.question: Failed-auth delinquent callers who still wanted to pay are process leakage - the verification-block cause, measured.

queries.title: Control total: collections-queue inbound by month
queries.question: The reconcilable number for the ops-reported call volumes - a large gap means calls this table does not carry, and the funnel denominator is a lower bound.

queries.title: Within-account contrast: captured vs leaked, same accounts
queries.question: Accounts with both a captured and a leaked intent episode: the month after each, compared within the account - the self-controlled causality read.

queries.title: Payment latency: how fast captured episodes pay
queries.question: Days from call to payment among captured intent episodes - separates paid-on-the-call from paid-eventually and validates the 30-day window from inside.

queries.title: The 202501 cohort ladder: month-max to month-end, step by step
queries.question: How does the Athena 493k month-MAX DQ1 entrant count step down toward Ishant's 186k month-END DLNQT_CD=1, and how big is each step?

queries.title: Entry-definition lookback: v11 lag vs strict December prior
queries.question: How much of the entrant count comes from v11's lag-over-present-months definition rather than a strict 202412 prior?

queries.title: Snapshot cadence in 202501: what month-end means here
queries.question: How many snapshot dates does an account carry in January 2025, and does the last one land on the calendar end of month?

queries.title: Month-end bucket by entry class: can a new roll land deep?
queries.question: Split the 202501 month-END delinquents by bucket and entry class - do deep buckets come from new rolls, prior delinquents, or accounts with no December row?

queries.title: Charge-off scope probes around January 2025
queries.question: How many accounts charge off in January with no delinquency bucket (straight-to-CO), while delinquent, or sit as pre-2025 CO stock still carrying rows?

queries.title: M2/M3 roll mirror: the January EOM bucket-1 stock, two months on
queries.question: Where does the January month-END bucket-1 stock sit at end February and end March, split by entrant vs already-delinquent - the shares to set against Ishant's M1=1 x M2 x M3 pivot?

queries.title: Call overlay: January inbound callers by bridge class
queries.question: How often does each bridge class call inbound in January - especially the month-max entrants who cure by month-end and are invisible to ASP?

queries.title: The 202501 cohort funnel: January calls per bridge class
queries.question: For the DQ1 cohort (classes a, b, c), how do January inbound episodes narrow from call to transcript to payment language to leaked to charged off within 8 months, per class?

queries.title: Cohort outcomes: charge-off by class and January caller status
queries.question: Within each bridge class, how do non-callers, captured callers, and leaked callers charge off at 8, 10, and 12 months - the shares to set against Ishant's CO_8M/10M/12M?

queries.title: Cohort language: what January callers say, per bridge class
queries.question: Which language group does each cohort episode fall into (promise, payment talk, plan, hardship, dispute, none), and what are each group's capture and 12-month charge-off rates?

queries.title: Cohort signal timing: who raises payment, how early, met by an offer?
queries.question: On the cohort's January episodes, does the customer or agent raise payment first, is intent visible in the first third of the call, and does customer intent meet an agent offer - each with its capture rate, per bridge class?

queries.title: Cleanup check: the pre-2025 charge-off exclusion, made visible
queries.question: Exactly which accounts the b7-b11 cleanup removes (old charge-off dates on January rows), and what the 31,810 deeper-path month-end entrants are made of.

queries.title: Cycle confound: cure-by-EOM by entry day-of-month
queries.question: How much of the 69/31 cured-vs-still split is in-month runway (entry day) rather than customer behavior?

queries.title: Mined phrases: captured vs leaked, still-DQ1 class
queries.question: Which customer bigrams/trigrams separate captured from leaked episodes in the cohort's hardest class?

queries.title: Mined phrases: charge-off vs survival, still-DQ1 class
queries.question: Which customer bigrams/trigrams mark the accounts that go on to charge off within 12 months?

queries.title: Ledger transitions: the cleaned Jan-31 bucket-1 ledger into February
queries.question: Where does the 204,323-account ledger sit at Feb EOM, split by caller class and in-month runway band - the full-count replacement for b6's truncated shares, with the cleaned Jan-31 EOM balance?

queries.title: The leak list followed forward: 2,394 leaked-intent accounts
queries.question: Where do the ledger's leaked-intent accounts sit at Feb and Mar EOM, how many charge off at 8/10/12 months, and how much of the list carries deceased-estate language?

queries.title: Within-cohort contrast: paid vs no-pay episodes, same ledger accounts
queries.question: For ledger accounts with BOTH a paid-30d and a no-pay-30d January intent episode, how do the two episode outcomes distribute over the account's Feb-EOM position - the cohort-native x4 guard?

queries.title: Call-day population: the operable January call stream
queries.question: How many January inbound episodes come from accounts delinquent AT CALL TIME, by bucket at call and days since the spell's first delinquent snapshot - the knowable-at-call-time sizing that makes the bucket-1 scope choice explicit?

queries.title: Join gap: verified-joined vs unjoinable January inbound, weekly
queries.question: Week by week, how many January inbound calls resolve to the account master, and of the joined, how many show a call-day bucket >= 1 - the historical baseline for pilot-time joinability?

queries.title: Deceased-estate group: the ledger's January callers, b10-style
queries.question: With a deceased-estate lexicon on top of the b10 partition, how do the ledger's 12,544 January episodes split, and what are each group's paid-30d, 8- and 12-month charge-off, and leaked-intent overlap - the routing-rule decision table?

queries.title: PII surface probe: transcript table twins (metadata only)
queries.question: Does the Athena transcript surface have a *_HI_SNSTV vs *_NON_PRV split, and which tables are in scope for a sample export?
